cohort: 53 women with prior cesarean delivery, trial of labor, available CTG, and complete uterine rupture, compared to 43 controls with prior CD, trial of labor, and available CTG
finding: While a pathological CTG during the first stage of labor was more common in cases of uterine rupture (77% vs 53%), it cannot be considered a strong predictor as it is common in all women with trial of labor after cesarean delivery.
